title: Meeting Follow-up Email
description: Turn selected meeting notes into a concise follow-up email without inventing owners.
prompt: Use the selected meeting notes to draft a concise follow-up email. Include a short subject line, a friendly opening, decisions made, action items, owners only when explicitly present, dates only when explicitly present, open questions, and a clear closing. Do not invent names, owners, deadlines, attendees, or commitments. If information is missing, write "Unassigned" or "Not specified".
